definitions.explanation: A secure storage box, typically installed at apartment buildings, where delivery drivers can leave packages when residents are not home.

examples.japanese: {宅配|たくはい}ボックスに{届|とど}いてた。
examples.english: It was delivered to the parcel locker.

examples.japanese: このマンションには{宅配|たくはい}ボックスがある。
examples.english: This apartment building has delivery lockers.

examples.japanese: {不在|ふざい}でも{宅配|たくはい}ボックスに{入|い}れてもらえるから{便利|べんり}だ。
examples.english: It's convenient because they can leave packages in the delivery locker even when I'm not home.

notes:
{宅配|たくはい}ボックス is a common amenity in Japanese apartment buildings ({集合住宅|しゅうごうじゅうたく}).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {宅配|たくはい}ボックスに{届|とど}く (to be delivered to the parcel locker)
- {宅配|たくはい}ボックスから{取|と}り{出|だ}す (to retrieve from the parcel locker)
- {宅配|たくはい}ボックス{付|つ}き (with delivery locker)

RELATED WORDS:
- {置|お}き{配|はい}: leave-at-door delivery
- {再配達|さいはいたつ}: redelivery
- {不在票|ふざいひょう}: missed delivery notice
